generatorDiffs.function: extractPairPlan + PairPlan + new renameOverviewCollisions helper + EN_OVERVIEW_HEADING const
generatorDiffs.lineRange: ~L339-362 (PairPlan interface + JSDoc + extractPairPlan); new const + helper inserted in this region
generatorDiffs.rationale: extractPairPlan is the natural home for collision detection — it already compares EN+ZH headings positionally. Adding overviewCollisionIndices (computed as indices where zh==='概述' && en==='Overview') lets retrofitPair know exactly which ZH 概述 headings are Overview renderings (NOT Summaries) without re-implementing the positional walk. Verified the trigger is precisely bounded: a repo-wide grep found 280 depth-4 ZH READMEs carrying `## 概述`; exactly 16 have an EN `## Overview` positional sibling (the collision set: embedder×3, data×5, eval×1, goal×2, llm×1, query×2, retrieval×2), and the other 264 have an EN `## Summary` sibling (already-conformant, carry frontmatter, planRetrofits skips them — and F1's Overview-specific detector would not fire on them anyway). The new renameOverviewCollisions helper mirrors insertAnchorsBeforeHeadings' heading-cursor walk (only `^## (.+)$` matches depth-2, so `#### KV Cache effect` depth-4 is skipped) so it rewrites only the positionally-correct 概述 occurrences. EN_OVERVIEW_HEADING is a named const (not inline) so the collision condition + rename target stay in lockstep.

This is where F1 actually lands — retrofitPair is the only call site that has BOTH the EN and ZH bodies, so it is the only place that can detect the cross-language 概述/Overview collision and rename the ZH side before staging. The rename MUST precede (a) frontmatter insertion, (b) anchor insertion, (c) insertSkeleton — because insertSkeleton's hasSummary(`^## 概述$`) check (L394) would otherwise match the un-renamed Overview and skip the Summary. Re-deriving the pair after the rename means pair.zhHeadings=[Overview, Model Experience, Known Limitations] and pair.slugs=[overview, ...] flow into insertAnchorsBeforeHeadings (threads <a id=overview> before the renamed ## Overview) and insertSkeleton (tocPairs sees Overview, not excluded → ZH TOC gains the Overview entry, matching EN's 4-item TOC). The `body === header + '
' + rest` re-stitch is exact because afterHeader splits body on '
' and rejoins slices 0..cursor and cursor..end (lines.slice(0,cursor).join('
') + '
' + lines.slice(cursor).join('
') === lines.join('
') === body). For the 49 clean packages overviewCollisionIndices is empty → the if-branch is skipped → pair=initialPair, zhCurrentRenamed=zhCurrent → behavior identical to today (F1 is a no-op for the 49).

Single-line but load-bearing: the ZH body handed to insertFrontmatter must be the RENAMED one (zhCurrentRenamed) so the 概述→Overview rename survives into zhStaged and onward into afterHeader()/insertAnchorsBeforeHeadings()/insertSkeleton(). The Retrofit result's `current` field stays `zhCurrent` (original) so the drift filter (current !== next) correctly flags the file as changed on the first run. frontmatterDescription(zhCurrent) is unchanged (description lives in frontmatter, which the rename does not touch — it only rewrites `## 概述` lines in the body).

pairingImpact: All 65 depth-4 target pairs go/stay GREEN. The 16 collision pairs (ZH 概述=Overview) currently regress under the bug to ZH 5 H2 vs EN 6 H2 + ZH TOC 3 links vs EN 4 links + missing #overview in ZH. F1 renames the 16 ZH 概述→Overview upstream, so insertSkeleton's hasSummary(概述) sees no pre-existing 概述 → inserts Summary 概述; the renamed Overview is NOT excluded by the tocPairs filter → ZH TOC gains the Overview entry (4 items, matching EN); insertAnchorsBeforeHeadings threads <a id=overview> before the renamed ## Overview (redundant with GitHub's native #overview slug, invisible to the signature). Result: both sides 6 H2 (Summary, TOC, Overview, Model Experience, Known Limitations, Dev Note) + 1 H4 (KV Cache) + 4 TOC links [#overview,#model-experience,#known-limitations-and-deferred-work,#dev-note] — identical heading-depth sequence + identical link-target sequence → pairing signature matches on all 16. The 49 clean: F1 is a no-op (overviewCollisionIndices empty) → unchanged, stay green. Authored-heading-text change: ZH `## 概述` (Overview) → `## Overview` (English) on EXACTLY 16 packages (embedder×3, data×5, eval×1, goal×2, llm×1, query×2, retrieval×2 — verified by repo-wide grep: 280 depth-4 ZH READMEs carry `## 概述`; 264 map to EN `## Summary` [already-conformant, out of scope], exactly 16 map to EN `## Overview` [the collision]); EN authored text UNCHANGED (Overview stays; only Summary/TOC/DevNote TODO-placeholders added). The rename is evidentially consistent: those 16 ZH docs already render `## Model Experience` + `## Known Limitations and Deferred Work` in English (verified in embedder/audit ZH files), so English structural headings are the established convention; and 264 conformant packages establish the 概述=Summary mapping, so F1 makes the 16 match the conformant Summary+Overview pattern. Corpus verify-translation-pairing: no NEW violations beyond the pre-existing 12-out-of-sync + 2-missing baseline (link-locale issues on tool-load-table-definition/tool-search-data-sources/query-tool/eval, NOT introduced by this retrofit — out of scope).
signatureSafe: Yes — idempotency + --check gate semantics preserved. (1) Idempotency: planRetrofits skips frontmatter-having files (the 130 targets gain frontmatter on first run → skipped on second run → '0 README files are current', drift=0). Edge case — frontmatter stripped + re-run: F1's detector requires enH2s[i]==='Overview' && zhHeadings[i]==='概述'; after the first run the ZH has `## Overview` (renamed) + `## 概述` (Summary, inserted); the Summary 概述 maps positionally to EN's `## Summary` (not Overview) → collision set empty → no rename; insertSkeleton's hasSummary(概述)=true + hasToc(目录)=true + hasDevNote(开发备注)=true → no re-insert → no-op. (2) --check gate (verify-package-readme-skeleton): runs planRetrofits() and reports drift; once all 130 carry frontmatter, planRetrofits returns [] → drift=0 → exit 0. (3) Generator idempotency contract ('a heading already present is not duplicated') preserved — the rename upstream is the ONLY mutation of authored text; insertSkeleton's hasSummary/hasToc/hasDevNote guards then see the renamed body and insert exactly once. (4) retrofitPair throw-guards (missing description, kind≠package-reference, divergent H2 counts) unchanged. (5) No signature risk: the rename is depth-preserving (both 概述 and Overview are H2) → signature-invisible (translation-pairing.ts:377 pushes node.depth only). (6) The redundant <a id=overview> anchor is an html node → not collected by the signature's visit switch (handles heading/code/table/list/link/definition only).
